analysis.note: Jabbit analysis. Every SLU-PP-332 result we found comes from mice or cells in a dish; no human has been given it in any published or registered trial. The headline endurance result came from 6 mice per group given injections; the developers later reported it lacks oral bioavailability and built an oral successor (SLU-PP-915). Developers disclose stock in companies working on ERR drugs. WADA bans it at all times from January 1, 2027.
